blocks.html: Moreover, several witnesses disclose the conspiracy made by the said Pierre Guerre, his wife and sons-in-law, to have the prisoner put to death and destroyed; even to having bargained with Jean Loze, consul of Palhé [Pailhès], whether he would furnish a certain sum of money on his part, and Pierre Guerre would defray the rest, to have the prisoner put to death: which the said Loze refused, saying that he would sooner give money to save him, for he was his kinsman, as Pierre Guerre himself had several times told and assured him. Moreover, they depose that the rumour at Artigat is that Pierre Guerre and his sons-in-law are making this prosecution against the will of the said de Rols; and that some of them have often heard the said Pierre Guerre say that the said prisoner was truly Martin Guerre, his nephew.
